pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal patches with serrated, non-smooth edges. Patch size is heterogeneous, with significantly larger spatial area on the upper flank and neck compared to smaller, more fragmented patches on the lower flank and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous, interconnected topological graph of light-cream negative space. Junction nodes generally connect three or more patches. Pathway thickness is non-uniform, showing slight narrowing at the midpoints between patches and broadening at junction vertices.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible reddish-brown mane along the upper neck and dorsal ridge. The silhouette displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated contour against the background foliage.
